messages.en:
It's spring, and you know
what that means? {01 00 00 0a 00}It's time
for the {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 14 00}As of next Monday, {01 00 00 0f 00}all of
us in town are gonna start
getting our hands dirty!
{07 0d 00}Stock up on flowers,
because it's time to start
prettying up the place!
messages.et:
Kevad on käes ja tead,
mida see tähendab? {01 00 00 0a 00}On aeg
{ff 00 00 03}lillepeoks{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 14 00}Järgmisest esmaspäevast{01 00 00 0f 00}
hakkame me kõik linnas
käsi mustaks tegema!
{07 0d 00}Varu lilli, sest on aeg
hakata kohta
ilusaks tegema!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm sure you know by now
that the {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00} starts
on Monday, {04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0b 00}What do you think I should
do?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}I have to start
planning my garden now!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa tead nüüdseks kindlasti,
et {ff 00 00 03}lillepidu{ff 00 00 00} algab
esmaspäeval, {04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0b 00}Mida ma sinu arust peaksin
tegema?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}Ma pean kohe oma
aeda planeerima hakkama!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00} is right
around the corner!{01 00 00 0f 00} In fact,
it starts on Monday.
{07 13 00}{0b 03 00}{04 03 00} is going to be 
filled with the fragrance
of flowery freshness!
{07 14 00}I wonder who's going to
have the best garden and
be the {ff 00 00 02}Green Thumb{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 03}Lillepidu{ff 00 00 00} on kohe ukse
taga!{01 00 00 0f 00} Tegelikult algab
see esmaspäeval.
{07 13 00}{0b 03 00}{04 03 00} täitub 
lillelise värskuse
lõhnaga!
{07 14 00}Huvitav, kellel on parim aed
ja kellest saab
{ff 00 00 02}rohenäpp{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
I can't wait until tomorrow!
That's when the {ff 00 00 03}Flower
Fest{ff 00 00 00} starts.
{07 0a 00}I'm so ready for it!{01 00 00 14 00} I've
been stockpiling fertilizer
for weeks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Ma ei jõua homset oodata!
Siis algab {ff 00 00 03}lille-
pidu{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 0a 00}Ma olen nii valmis!{01 00 00 14 00} Ma olen
nädalaid väetist
varunud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Saturday marks the start
of {04 03 00}'s annual
{ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 14 00}Every Saturday for a
month!{01 00 00 05 00} It's going to be so
exciting, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Be sure to stick around,
because {04 03 00}'s got a
{ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00} on Saturday!
{07 16 00}The noise of the fireworks
scares me, but I love the
explosions, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Jää kindlasti siia,
sest {04 03 00} on
laupäeval {ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 16 00}Ilutulestiku müra hirmutab
mind, aga ma armastan
plahvatusi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}I can't wait, I can't wait!{01 00 00 0a 00}
I'm sooo looking forward to
the weekend!
{07 00 00}As if you didn't know,{01 00 00 05 00} we're
having a fabulous {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks
Show {ff 00 00 00}on Saturday!
{07 06 00}I can't wait, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I look forward to these
all year long!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Ma ei jõua oodata, ei jõua!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Ma ootan nädalavahetust
nii väga!
{07 00 00}Nagu sa ei teaks,{01 00 00 05 00} meil on
laupäeval vapustav
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 06 00}Ma ei jõua oodata,{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ma ootan neid terve
aasta!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's almost Saturday! I've
been waiting so long to see
fireworks light up the sky!
Only a few more days until
the {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}! It's
gonna be a blast!{01 00 00 05 00} Hee hee!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Laupäev on peaaegu käes! Ma
olen nii kaua oodanud, et
näha taevas ilutulestikku!
Veel vaid paar päeva kuni
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushowni{ff 00 00 00}! See tuleb
võimas!{01 00 00 05 00} Hi hii!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}I can't believe it's almost
here!{01 00 00 05 00} Glorious fireworks
against a summer sky!
{07 14 00}That's right! We've got a
{ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00} tomorrow,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}You should come with me.
We'll get lost in the
'splodiness together!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Ma ei suuda uskuda, et see
on peaaegu käes!{01 00 00 05 00} Hiilgav
ilutulestik suvetaevas!
{07 14 00}Just nii! Meil on homme
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}Sa peaksid minuga tulema.
Me kaome koos
paukumisse!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0b 00}how much do
you know about the {ff 00 00 03}Acorn
Festival{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}It also goes by the name
Nutsgiving Day.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Dunno why,
'cuz it lasts all week.
{07 14 00}In fact, it's the only week
when you can harvest
{ff 00 00 07}acorns{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0b 00}kui palju sa
tead {ff 00 00 03}tõrupeost{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Seda kutsutakse ka
tõrupäevaks.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ei tea miks,
sest see kestab nädala.
{07 14 00}Tegelikult on see ainus
nädal, mil saab korjata
{ff 00 00 07}tõrusid{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Hey, {04 1f 00}, do you
know what time it is? It's
time to get nuts!
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 07}Acorns{ff 00 00 00}, to be specific! It's
almost {04 03 00}'s {ff 00 00 03}Acorn
Festival{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}There's something about the
autumn breeze that knocks
{ff 00 00 07}acorns{ff 00 00 00} off the trees!
It's a magical week!
{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00}And it's almost here,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Hei, {04 1f 00}, kas sa
tead, mis kell on? On aeg
pähkleid koguda!
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 07}Tõrusid{ff 00 00 00}! Peagi
on {04 03 00} {ff 00 00 03}tõru-
pidu{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Sügistuules on midagi,
mis raputab {ff 00 00 07}tõrud{ff 00 00 00}
puudelt alla!
See on võluv nädal!
{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00}Ja see on peaaegu käes,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Monday's just around the
corner, and the {ff 00 00 03}Acorn
Festival{ff 00 00 00} is coming!
{07 16 00}{ff 00 00 07}Acorns {ff 00 00 00}are so smooth and 
shiny. I love the way their
husks feel.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 13 00}I hope I find a lot, so I
can fill my whole room with
acorns and jump into them!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Esmaspäev on kohe käes ja
{ff 00 00 03}tõrupidu{ff 00 00 00}
tuleb!
{07 16 00}{ff 00 00 07}Tõrud {ff 00 00 00}on nii siledad ja 
läikivad. Mulle meeldib
nende kestade tunne.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 13 00}Loodan, et leian palju, et
saaksin täita terve toa
tõrudega ja neisse hüpata!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}It's finally time!{01 00 00 0f 00} Usually,
{04 03 00} has nothing
but fruit in its trees.
{07 00 00}But starting tomorrow, for
one magical week, we'll have
delicious {ff 00 00 07}acorns{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 14 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Acorn Festival{ff 00 00 00} starts
tomorrow, you see?{01 00 00 0f 00} I can't
wait, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Lõpuks on aeg!{01 00 00 0f 00} Tavaliselt
on {04 03 00} puudel
ainult puuvili.
{07 00 00}Aga homsest, ühe võluva
nädala jooksul, on meil
maitsvad {ff 00 00 07}tõrud{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 03}Tõrupidu{ff 00 00 00} algab
homme, näed?{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma ei jõua
oodata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Can you believe it's almost
time for {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00}?
It sneaks up on you!
It starts on Monday, and it
lasts for a week. Everyone
decorates their houses.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}It makes even the most
dreary winter seem
wonderful, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Kas sa suudad uskuda, et
peagi on {ff 00 00 03}valgusööde{ff 00 00 00} aeg?
See hiilib ligi!
See algab esmaspäeval ja
kestab nädala. Kõik
kaunistavad oma maju.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}See paneb isegi kõige
nukrama talve imeliseks
tunduma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} you're going to
see a little change here
in {04 03 00} pretty soon.
The {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00} party
starts soon, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
It lasts all week long.
{07 0d 00}All I can tell you is,{01 00 00 05 00} be
sure to visit us every day!
It's a sight, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} sa näed siin
{04 03 00} varsti
väikest muutust.
{ff 00 00 03}Valgusööde{ff 00 00 00} pidu algab
varsti, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
See kestab terve nädala.
{07 0d 00}Ma võin sulle öelda vaid,{01 00 00 05 00} et
käi meil kindlasti iga päev!
See on vaatemäng, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I love the snow, the lights,{01 00 00 0f 00}
and the parties! The {ff 00 00 03}Bright
Nights{ff 00 00 00} of winter are near!
{07 13 00}Oh, I can't wait to see all
those houses all lit up and
prettified, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma armastan lund, tulesid{01 00 00 0f 00}
ja pidusid! Talve {ff 00 00 03}valgusööd
{ff 00 00 00}on lähedal!
{07 13 00}Oh, ma ei jõua oodata, et
näha kõiki neid maju
valgustatuna, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{04 03 00}'s {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00}
celebration is coming soon.
You have to check it out.
{07 00 00}For one fun, freezing week,
starting Monday, make sure
you stay healthy and fit!
{07 14 00}You should drink lots of
hot {04 13 00} so
that you don't miss a day!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{04 03 00} {ff 00 00 03}valgusööde{ff 00 00 00}
pidu tuleb varsti.
Sa pead seda vaatama.
{07 00 00}Ühe lõbusa, külmetava
nädala jooksul esmaspäevast
hoolitse, et püsid terve!
{07 14 00}Sa peaksid jooma palju
kuuma {04 13 00}, et
sa ei jätaks päevagi vahele!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's almost time{01 00 00 0f 00} for the
{ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00} to start!

{07 16 00}Make sure you get a good
night's rest, or you'll be
dead on your feet!
{07 0d 00}You don't want to miss a
single day of this festive
week, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Peagi on aeg{01 00 00 0f 00}, et
{ff 00 00 03}valgusööd{ff 00 00 00} algaksid!

{07 16 00}Hoolitse, et sa saaksid
hästi magada, või sa oled
surnud väsimusest!
{07 0d 00}Sa ei taha vahele jätta
ühtegi päeva sellest
peonädalast, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
